title: Low-poly logo reveal — wireframe, flying facets, app icon, typed wordmark

source.author: @tdinh_me
source.note: Remade from scratch in HyperFrames after the TypingMind low-poly logo reveal; structure and pacing follow it. The brain is replaced by the Claude Imagine mark, rebuilt from its own 16 faces.

scenes: wireframe of the mark draws itself from the bottom vertex, node by node
65 facets fly in with spin and motion trails and land from the bottom up
glow, bloom and an expanding double ring
the app tile grows behind the mark and the real logo resolves over the low-poly version
the icon moves into a lockup, the wordmark is typed with a caret, subtitle fades in
notes: The mark lives in assets/mesh.js, generated by tools/mesh.py from assets/logo.png (the warm logo proposed with the site restyle). To use the purple production logo: copy public/logo.png to assets/logo.png, rerun `uv run --with pillow python3 tools/mesh.py assets/logo.png > assets/mesh.js`, and set tile to #0f0f2a. For another brand, replace PTS and FACETS in tools/mesh.py with that mark's faces.
